questions.question: A student who scores 25% fails by 15 marks, while a student who receives 75% surpasses the passing standard by 35%. Determine the highest possible score.
questions.solution:

A student who scores 25% fails by 15 marks

Student who receives 75% surpasses the passing standard by 35%

According to question,

⇒ 25% + 15 = 75% - 35%

⇒ 25% + 15 = 40% 

⇒ 15% = 15

⇒ 1% = 1

⇒ 100% = 100

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**

questions.question: Five men can do a work in 12 days while 10 women can do the same work in 8 days. In how many days can 3 men and 4 women together complete the work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = 5M × 12 = 10W × 8 ⇒ 60M = 80W.

Efficiency ratio (M/W) = 80 ÷ 60 = 4/3.

Total work = 60 × 4 = 240 units.

Time taken by 3M and 4W = 240 ÷ (3 × 4 + 4 × 3) = 240 ÷ 24 = 10.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ 5 men can complete the work in 12 days.

⇒ 1 man can complete the work in 5 × 12 = 60 days.

⇒ 10 women can complete the work in 8 days.

⇒ 1 woman can complete the work in 10 × 8 = 80 days.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of 1 man = 4 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of 1 woman = 3 units/day

⇒ Combined efficiency of 3 men and 4 women = (3 × 4) + (4 × 3) = 12 + 12 = 24 units/day

questions.question: The ratio of the weight of Ram, Shyam and Mohan is 7 ∶ 8 ∶ 5 respectively. The average weight of Ram, Shyam and Mohan is 80 kg. What is the average weight of Ram and Shyam?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the weights of Ram, Shyam, and Mohan be 7x, 8x, and 5x respectively.

Total weight = 7x + 8x + 5x = 20x.

Since the average weight is 80 kg, total weight = 80 × 3 = 240 kg.

20x = 240 ⇒ x = 12 kg.

Average weight of Ram and Shyam = (7x + 8x) ÷ 2 = 7.5x = 7.5 × 12 = 90 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 90 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

⇒ Total weight of Ram, Shyam, and Mohan = Average weight × Number of persons

⇒ Total weight = 80 × 3 = 240 kg

⇒ Sum of ratio parts = 7 + 8 + 5 = 20 parts

⇒ Weight of Ram = 7 × 12 = 84 kg

⇒ Weight of Shyam = 8 × 12 = 96 kg

⇒ Total weight of Ram and Shyam = 84 + 96 = 180 kg

When a total sum is distributed in a given ratio (a : b : c), the value of any specific share is calculated as: Share = (Ratio part ÷ Sum of all parts) × Total Value.

questions.question: If a train runs at 6/7th of its original speed, then it reaches the station 20 minutes late. Find out the usual time taken by train to cover the distance.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

New speed = (6/7) × original speed

Delay = 20 minutes

**Calculations:**

Let the original speed be S and the original time be T minutes.

Distance = Speed × Time

Using the original speed:

Distance = S × T ....(1)

Using the new speed:

Distance = (6/7)S × (T + 20) ....(2)

Set equations (1) and (2) equal:

S × T = (6/7)S × (T + 20)

Cancel S from both sides:

T = (6/7)(T + 20)

⇒ 7T = 6T + 120

⇒ T = 120 minutes

**∴ The usual time taken by the train to cover the distance is 120 minutes.**

questions.question: A trader earns a profit of 30% by selling an article X and loses 16% by selling another article Y. If the ratio of the cost prices of X and Y is 3 ∶ 4, then what is the gain/loss in the entire transaction (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
Given:

A trader earns a profit of 30% by selling an article X and loses 16% by selling another article Y. 

The ratio of the cost prices of X and Y is 3 ∶ 4.

Concept used:

Profit% = {Profit over Cost Price} times 100\%

Selling Price = Cost Price - Cost Price × Loss%

Selling Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Gain%

Calculation:

Let the cost price of X and Y be Rs. 300 and Rs. 400.

Total cost price = 300 + 400 = Rs. 700

Selling price of X = 300 + 300 × 30% = Rs. 390

Selling price of Y = 400 - 400 × 16% = Rs. 336

Total selling price = 390 + 336 = Rs. 726

Gain made = 726 - 700 = Rs. 26

Now, gain% in the entire transaction = {26 over 700} times 100\% ≈ 3.7%

∴ The gain in the entire transaction is** ****3.7%.**

questions.question: The average weight of 17 men is 63 kg and the average weight of 36 women is 54 kg. What is the average weight (in kg) of all the men and women together? (Rounded off to the nearest integer)

Assume the base average = 54 kg.

Deviation for 17 men = 17 × (63 − 54) = 17 × 9 = +153 kg.

Average deviation per person = +153 ÷ (17 + 36) = 153 ÷ 53 ≈ +2.88 kg.

Combined average = Base average + Average deviation = 54 + 2.88 = 56.88 kg.

Rounding off to the nearest integer gives 57.

**∴ The correct answer is 57 kg.**

questions.question: The whole surface area of a pyramid whose base is a regular polygon is 260 cm2 and the area of its base is 120 cm2. The area of each lateral face is 20 cm2. Then the number of lateral faces is:

Total Lateral Surface Area = Total Surface Area − Base Area

⇒ Total Lateral Area = 260 − 120 = 140 cm²

**The most useful training of my career was given to me by my boss. **

options.text: My boss has been giving me the most useful training of my career.
My boss gives me the most useful training.
My boss is giving me the most useful training.
My boss gave me the most useful training of my career.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"My boss gave me the most useful training of my career."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence **"The most useful training of my career was given to me by my boss" **is in passive voice.
 
• In this sentence, the subject is the object of the action (the most useful training of my career).
 
• To convert this to active voice, we need to move the doer of the action **('my boss') **to the subject position, followed by the past simple form of the verb (which is inferred from the past tense 'was given' used in the original sentence), and then the direct object as the receiver of the action ('the most useful training of my career').
 
• The correct conversion to active voice would be: **"My boss gave me the most useful training of my career."**
 
 
• **Structure: Original Sentence (Passive): **"The most useful training of my career was given to me by my boss."
 
• **Structure: **Subject (The most useful training of my career) + auxiliary verb (was) + past participle (given) + preposition (to) + indirect object (me) + preposition (by) + agent (my boss).
 
• **Correct Conversion to Active: **"My boss gave me the most useful training of my career."
 
• **Structure: **Subject (My boss) + Verb in past simple form (gave) + indirect object (me) + Direct Object (the most useful training of my career).
 
 
 
• Hence, the elements of the sentences have been rearranged and the verb form changed to give the sentence in the active voice, properly reflecting the original sentence's meaning and tense.
 
• The agent **'my boss' **from the passive sentence becomes the subject of the active sentence and the subject from the passive sentence **'the most useful training of my career' **becomes the object of the active sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Let's understand the other options: **

 
 
• **"My boss has been giving me the most useful training of my career." - **Changes the tense to present perfect continuous, not mirroring the original past simple tense.
 
• **"My boss gives me the most useful training." - **Changes the tense to present simple, again not reflecting the original past simple tense.
 
• **"My boss is giving me the most useful training." - **Changes the tense to present continuous, which does not accurately reflect the original sentence's past simple tense.

• The heat wave had a significant impact on water resources in Europe, leading to reduced river flow and water shortages.
 
• Reduced cloud cover and increased solar radiation led to increased temperatures and dryness.

Which of the above assumptions is/are valid?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**2 only"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Statement 1 is not a valid assumption.
 
 
• From the passage '.... *This has caused **rivers and streams to swell and has increased the risk of flooding** and landslides in some areas*. ’
 
• This indicates that the** heat wave can have a significant impact on rivers in Europe, leading to a risk to flooding and landslides.** The high temperatures can cause an increased the melting of ice, leading to increased water flow in the river and high risk of flooding and landslides.__ Thus, the given statement is not valid.
 
 
 
• Statement 2 is a valid assumption.
 __
 
• From the passage '.... *Another impact of the **heat wave is the early arrival of spring in many parts of Europe**. Satellite images show fields and forests that are already green, **with flowers and trees in bloom, months ahead of schedule*****.**..….’
 
• This indicates that reduced cloud cover and **increased solar radiation can lead to increased temperatures and dryness.** The clouds usually act as a shield, reflecting a certain amount of sunlight back into space and reducing the amount of heat absorbed by the ground. If there is less cloud cover, more solar radiation can reach the ground, leading to increased temperatures and dryness.__
 
 

**Hence, the correct answer is** "*2 only."*

questions.question: Which scientist explained that cells divide and new cells are formed from pre-existing cells?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rudolf Virchow.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Rudolf Virchow expanded the cell theory and suggested that **all the cells arise from pre-existing cells.**
 
• The cell theory, given by **Rudolf Virchow in 1855**, states that:
 
 
• All living organisms are made up of cells.
 
• The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of life.
 
• All cells arise from pre-existing cells.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Theodore Schwann**

 
• He was a **British Zoologist who in 1839, studied different types of animal cells.**
 
• On the basis of this, Schwann proposed the hypothesis that the bodies of animals and plants are composed of cells and products of cells.

**Anton Van Leeuwenhoek**

 
• He is known as **"the Father of Microbiology"**.
 
• He discovered "protozoa" - the single-celled organisms. 

**Robert Hooke**

 
• **He discovered cells by observing them in a cork slice** in 1665.
 
• Under a microscope, he could only see honey- comb-like structures in a slice of cork.
 
• Since that was a dead tissue, he could only see the cell walls.
 
• **He thus coined the term ‘Cell’.**

__
 
• Pateti is the **new year festival** of the Parsis.
 
• Pateti comes from the Persian word '**Patet'** which means '**confession' or 'repentance'.**
 
• On this festival, Parsis mark the beginning of the new year, go to the agyari and spend the day with family members.
 
• The Parsis don’t just believe in celebrating the new year and forgetting about the past. Rather they cherish the past and look back on the year that has passed and ask for repentance.
 
• This generally occurs just before the New year or the last day of the previous year and usually encompasses **5 days **of repentance which has now been reduced to **one**. 
 
• New year's day which historically falls on the **spring equinox** is now celebrated in **mid-August every year**.
 
• The **Shahenshahi** calendar used by the Parsis is itself known as **Nowroz.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• Zoroastrianism spread to the world via the Silk Route and influenced other religions such as Judaism and Christianity. It is a monotheistic religion established by the Prophet Zarathustra who was the contemporary of Cyrus the Great, back in 1200 BC.
 
• The Parsis, came to India after the Arab conquest started. Historians believe that they sailed across the Arabian Sea to reach **Gujarat sometime in 785 AD.** Today, around **60,000** Parsis reside in the country.
 
• The Parsis are a distinctive community in the country who are known for their distinct cuisine and way of life. Many of them such as **Jamshedji Tata** have contributed to building this nation.
 
• This community is predominantly based in the western region, especially in **Maharashtra and Gujarat.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Hazrat Muhammad Sahib was born in Mecca in 570 AD.
 
• Hazrat Muhammad Sahib died in 632 AD. After his death, Islam got divided into two sects called **Sunni and Shia**.
 
• The successors of Prophet Muhammad were called **Khalifa**.
 
 
 
• **Sikh religion -**
